title: 长难句专项练习
passage: 长难句结构拆解专项训练：分析下列句子的主干、从句类型和修饰关系。

questions.question_text:
The idea that some groups of people may be more intelligent than others is one of those hypotheses that dare not speak its name.

这句话的主干是什么？

options.A: The idea is one of those hypotheses
options.B: some groups may be more intelligent
options.C: hypotheses dare not speak its name
options.D: people may be more intelligent than others

questions.analysis: 句子主干是 The idea is one of those hypotheses。that some groups...others 是同位语从句修饰 idea，that dare not speak its name 是定语从句修饰 hypotheses。

questions.question_text:
It is not easy to explain why some animals survive in environments where most others would perish.

句中 where 引导的是什么从句？
questions.analysis: where 引导地点状语从句，修饰 survive，表示"在大多数其他动物会灭亡的环境中"。

questions.question_text:
Having been ignored for decades, the old building, which was once a grand palace, now faces demolition.

句中 Having been ignored 是什么成分？
questions.analysis: Having been ignored 是现在分词完成被动式作原因状语，逻辑主语是 the old building。

questions.question_text:
The report, published last week, shows that the economy is growing faster than most analysts had predicted.

句中有几个从句？
questions.analysis: 两个从句：1) that the economy...predicted 是宾语从句；2) than most analysts had predicted 是比较状语从句。published last week 是过去分词短语作定语，不是从句。

questions.question_text:
Not only did the company fail to meet its targets, but it also had to lay off hundreds of employees.

这句话使用了什么语法结构？
questions.analysis: Not only 置于句首引起部分倒装，助动词 did 提前。这是 not only...but also... 的倒装结构。
